checks.label: 1) Adding 100 irrelevant profile fields does not improve rank
checks.evidence: Ranking comparator no longer uses profileCompletenessScore tie-break.

checks.label: 2) Adding duplicate evidence does not improve rank
checks.evidence: Comparator does not use evidence-count or source-volume features as ranking input.

checks.label: 3) UNKNOWN does not equal NO
checks.evidence: Traceability keeps UNKNOWN separate from verified NO.

checks.label: 4) Missing information does not create a negative penalty
checks.evidence: Unresolved evidence affects confidence, not direct negative scoring.

checks.label: 5) Verified case-critical positive evidence can strengthen recommendation
checks.evidence: Ranking includes governed fit then proven match from verified evidence.

checks.label: 6) Verified negative evidence can weaken recommendation
checks.evidence: Governed MUST failures are enforced before ranking.

checks.label: 7) Facility-supplied unverified claims do not improve rank
checks.evidence: Unverified metadata signals are LIMITED and do not contribute to proven YES.

checks.label: 8) Verification of previously critical UNKNOWN can change ranking when relevant
checks.evidence: When verification memory resolves UNKNOWN to verified YES/NO, proven score updates.

checks.label: 9) Evidence Confidence is separate from Quality
checks.evidence: Coverage/confidence fields are explicit and separate from clinical quality features.

checks.label: 10) Deeply researched facility does not win merely because it was deeply researched
checks.evidence: Ranking does not use generic completeness/source volume as a tie-break.
